output_excerpt: {"observations":["hawking/odyssey.py is documented as a resident-facing bridge into the live mid-flight Odyssey-I driver under tools/odyssey_ctl.py; it shells out to existing driver subcommands and adds nothing to the curriculum.","The module declares ODYSSEY_STATE.json as driver-owned and read-only from this module, while HAWKING_LEDGER.json is HAWKING-owned and this module is the only writer.","The inspect capability class is documented as read-only and unconditional: status, queue, value, economics, completions(), and patient() never write or spend.","admit_check is explicitly not registered because cmd_admit calls reclaim_if_tight(), which can run tools/reclaim_safe.sh below DISK_WARN_GIB and delete build caches and finished lane directories.","The continue capability class includes harvest, write_packet, run, cycle, retire, acquire_next, completions(rebuild=True), and gravity_gauntlet; each can mutate persistent Odyssey state, spawn a subprocess, or start a download.","Every continue-class verb requires confirm=True or raises PermissionError, mirroring the benchmark.run/accelerator.benchmark gate in hawking/tool_registry.py.","A dry_run=True path, where the driver has one, needs no confirm because the driver itself launches nothing in that mode.","The own capability class includes ingest, add_to_eligibility, park_specimen, record_law, record_scar, create_transfer_probe, and create_adversarial_probe.","Own-class writes land in HAWKING_LEDGER.json, alongside but never inside the driver's ODYSSEY_STATE.json, so they cannot race the driver's own cycle/harvest/retire writers.","ingest reads both real on-disk states and is read-only; the other six own-class verbs mutate the ledger and gate on confirm=True before the ledger is loaded, so a refusal touches no file.","Odyssey II (transfer) and III (adversarial) probes require a law already recorded via record_law; that is the only ordering enforced, so I/II/III can overlap the moment a law is claimed, per the campaign's no-phase-barrier rule.","The module defines REPO, ODYSSEY_CTL, ODYSSEY_DIR, PATIENTS_DIR, STATE_PATH, LEDGER_PATH, and _LEDGER_LISTS as its path and ledger-list constants.","_run invokes sys.executable with ODYSSEY_CTL, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, and a timeout; it has special handling for acquire-next --dry-run when returncode is 1 and stdout starts with REFUSE."],"sources":["hawking/odyssey.py (sha256:41f616eddc2a485173099a8f3d089463fb4e9a1815f384f91891912fed223b7d; 20488 bytes; observed first 4000 bytes)"],"recommendations":["Run the admitted focused tests hawking/test_odyssey.py, hawking/test_modellake_index_mount_guard.py, and tools/odyssey/test_modellake_watch.py to obtain deterministic pass/fail evidence.","Inspect the remaining admitted focus files hawking/modellake_gate.py, hawking/test_odyssey.py, hawking/test_modellake_index_mount_guard.py, tools/odyssey/modellake_watch.py, and tools/odyssey/test_modellake_watch.py for the ModelLake admission boundary and watch scheduling seam.","Verify the exact confirm=True gate implementation and the acquire-next --dry-run REFUSE special case in the full hawking/odyssey.py source.","Confirm whether the no-phase-barrier scheduling seam is implemented only by the record_law ordering rule or also enforced in modellake_watch.py."],"unresolved_questions":["The admitted focused tests were not run in this observation, so deterministic test results remain unverified.","The full hawking/odyssey.py source beyond the first 4000 bytes was not observed, so exact gate and _run implementation details remain unconfirmed.","The owner and behavior of the ModelLake admission boundary in hawking/modellake_gate.py were not observed.","The no-phase-barrier scheduling seam in tools/odyssey/modellake_watch.py was not observed.","Whether the documented no-phase-barrier rule is enforced by tests in tools/odyssey/test_modellake_watch.py remains unverified."],"child_worker_ids":[],"status":"STRUCTURED_RESULT_READY"}
